title: Hardening Contract
claim: Before any user-derived node metadata is dereferenced or used as a copy bound, validate the cursor against the trusted 0x4000-byte pool, require 0x400 alignment, require next to equal the fixed ring successor, and require 0 <= data_size <= 1000 and 0 <= cursor_count <= data_size. On invalid state, stop RTP, disable AEI, clear the IRQ, reset cursor/count/loop only through trusted kernel pointers, and return without copying.

evidence.observation: Fixed circular order needed to calculate the only valid successor.

evidence.locator: copy loop and current legacy bounds_failure
evidence.observation: Existing guard checks do not establish node pointer topology or the full data_size contract.

evidence.locator: copy loop and stream restart/AEI enable
evidence.observation: Worker must abort before starting/restarting RTP or enabling AEI when validation fails.

inferences: The expected successor can be computed from (node - head) / 0x400 and wraps from offset 0x3c00 to head.
obligations_before_completion: Implement and review the guard before changing source.
Keep exact semantic promotion withdrawn for any hardened deviation.
Run pinned Joern and two clean canonical Docker builds after source changes.
Record ABI/import and assembly differences; do not infer stock equivalence from successful compilation.
scope: Richtap shared FIFO used by richtap_update_fifo_data and richtap_rtp_work; offline NX809J stock evidence only.
